letter.company_line: Bendigo structural and civil consultancy working across Victoria and southern NSW, with AutoCAD and Civil 3D in the office
letter.subject: Draftsperson, Bendigo
paragraphs: I am applying for the Draftsperson path on your Structural Engineer or Draftsperson role in Bendigo, listed on SEEK. Your note that you welcome people just starting out, together with AutoCAD and Civil 3D in the office, is why I wanted to write.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design documented in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). My CAD work so far is from study rather than a paid Australian drafting role.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings, doing inspections and keeping site and material records. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for regional work.
I would welcome the chance to talk about joining your Bendigo team as a draftsperson. I have attached my resume and cover letter.
